'''''Scent''''' may refer to the following:

* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 31|On the Scent]]'' - the thirty-first chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 6|The Scent of Madness]]'' - the sixth chapter of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.
* ''[[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 6|The Scent of a Dream]]'' - the sixth chapter of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 44|Scents Unknown]]'' - the forty-forth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

* [[Shadowspawn#Darkhounds|Darkhounds]] - Shadowspawn creatures which can track by scent.

* [[Sniffer]] - someone who can literally smell violence.
